title: EPILOGUE // VAULTS OF VALYRIA
narrative: In the deepest subterranean vaults beneath the Hightower, Euron breaks the seal of the Archmaesters. Forbidden blood scrolls from ancient Valyria reveal the true origin of dragons and men. Armed with the lost magic of the Freehold, the Crow's Eye reshapes the world in his eldritch image.
